descripcion: Brewery founded in 1893 in the port district of Iwase, Toyama. Among the first in the country to bet on daiginjo.
Brewery founded in 1916 in Toyama that brews year-round rather than only in winter, releasing its whole output under the Haneya label.
Tonami brewery, among the largest in the Hokuriku region, brewing with meltwater from the Tateyama range.
Brewery founded in 1880 in Gokayama, an extreme-snow area and a World Heritage site for its gassho-zukuri houses.
Himi brewery, the only one in Toyama still using the traditional fune press. Its kura was destroyed by the 2024 Noto earthquake and is being rebuilt.
